note: Wednesday A, workplace English（职场英语）: 事 si6 ×3, then BBC 6 Minute English “Are microplastics harming us?” (~6 min). Hard recall first (en-0182, 0185, 0186, 0188, 0189): say each aloud before flipping, then a from-memory run-through. Recap of recent workplace cards. 3 new BBC words (correlation / quantified / emerging) only if some Hard cards come back Good. Then a 30–60 sec mid-week update (point → reason → example). 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.title: BBC 6 Minute English: “Are microplastics harming us?” (listen ~6 min; notice correlation / quantified / emerging)

tasks.prompt: Workplace output, 30–60 sec: mid-week daily update. “Here's where I am today, and what I'll finish this afternoon.” Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.
tasks.script:
Point: Here's my mid-week update: I'll finish the current task this afternoon and send a short note by the end of the day.
Reason: I want you to have a clear picture of where things stand before tomorrow.
Example: This morning I'm checking the numbers; if anything looks off, I'll flag it early rather than wait.

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls.

questions.q: BBC: how long would it take to ingest a credit-card-sized amount of microplastics?
questions.explain: The answer in the episode is 23,000 years (not the popular ‘a credit card a week’ claim).

options: a relationship between two or more things
a measurement with an exact number
questions.explain: correlation = 相关关系。quantified = given a number; a spike = a sudden sharp increase.

questions.q: A mid-week daily update should cover…
options: where you are today, and what you'll finish this afternoon
only what went wrong last month
questions.explain: 今日进展 + 今天下午要完成什么。
先说重点，再讲原因，最后举例。
